html.author: Author
html.help_using_maplat: This site is built with open-source pictorial and historical map viewer Maplat.
html.help_operation_content:
Move the map by dragging with a mouse on a PC or swiping with a finger on a smartphone.
Zoom the map with the upper-left buttons on a PC, or by pinching in and out with two fingers on a smartphone.
On a smartphone, rotate the map by twisting two fingers.
Use the upper-left button to return to the home position of the displayed map.
The compass on the button points north; press it to reset the map rotation.
While the map is moving, the buttons disappear to show the entire map. To bring them back, wait a moment or click or tap the screen once.
html.help_selection_content:
Two sliders with thumbnails like appear at the lower left and lower right of the screen. Use them to select a map to display.
Slide to choose a map, then click its thumbnail to switch to it.
The lower-left slider selects base maps (accurate maps); the lower-right slider selects historical or illustrated maps.
html.help_gps_title: Showing current position on the map
html.help_gps_content:
When you press the button, the GPS function turns on and the user's current location is displayed on the map as .
If you press the button again, the GPS function turns off.
If the user's current location is not on the map being displayed, a message will be displayed and the GPS function will be turned off automatically.
html.help_poi_content:
Markers such as may appear on the map where spot information is available.
Click or tap a marker to display the spot information.
html.help_etc_attr: Button: Shows information about the currently displayed map, such as its creator, contributor, and license.
html.help_share_help: Button: Opens a screen for sharing this app on social networks and elsewhere.
html.help_etc_border:
Button: Shows map borders.
You can also switch maps by clicking inside a border.
On a PC, hover over a map to select it and click to switch; on a smartphone, tap once to select a map and tap again to switch.
html.help_etc_marker_list: Button: Opens a screen for showing or hiding each marker layer.
html.help_etc_slider:
Slider: Adjusts the transparency of the displayed map so that the base map can be seen through it.
This works only while historical or illustrated maps are displayed; it does not work with base maps.

app.fake_explanation: NOTE: If GPS result is more than %2$d km away from %1$s, the system issues a pseudo-coordinate around %1$s.
app.out_of_map_desc: The GPS position is outside the map. GPS turns off.
app.out_of_map_area: The displayed area is outside the map. Returning to the default position.
app.user_gps_deny: To display the current location, please enable "Use Location" in your web browser and read the QR code or URL again.
app.gps_miss: The system could not acquire your location. Try again where GPS satellite signals are easier to receive.
app.gps_timeout: Acquiring the position timed out. Try again where GPS satellite signals are easier to receive.
